strings: #13A pity you won't see your revenge. Soldiers -- get rid of him!
#13You've got skills, but you're no match for a Templar Assassin!
#13Keep a lookout! Don't let anyone pass!
#11Hm. Lee is trying to make a getaway, but I don't think he'll get far...
#01There's nowhere left for you to run, Charles. It's over. All of it.
#13Naïve as ever, I see. The battle never ends. Not for men like us.
#13You may be the hero today, but for your Sons of Liberty, the war is over. And so is your usefulness.
#13They can't control you, so they'll fear you, and when they finally come for you, you'll realize the truth I've known all along.
#13There's no place in this world for our kind.
